title: MarsDisplay · Settings refresh
brief: Three settings alternatives using existing Qt tokens and controls. Preserve 650px desktop width, explicit save and device selection, runtime locking and honest host-completion wording. HTML mockups only; production unchanged.

artboards.title: Clear sections
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar numbered groups. Easy to learn; more vertical scrolling.

artboards.title: Task navigation
artboards.tradeoff: Separate setup, startup and diagnostics. Less clutter; another click to reach some settings.

artboards.title: Compact console
artboards.tradeoff: Settings and capture health together. Fast to scan; denser and less room for guidance.
